thinking:
学途 (XueTu) - Online learning platform.
Languages, Computer Skills, Exam Preparation.
University students and young professionals.

        *   Home page (`index.html`).
        *   Course list page (`courses.html`).
        *   Course detail page (`course-detail.html`).
        *   Sign-up page (`signup.html`).

        *   Multiple files (index + at least 2 others).
        *   Relative links, same tab.
        *   CSS/JS internal (no remote loads).
        *   Language: Simplified Chinese.
        *   Realistic content (no Lorem Ipsum).
        *   Forms/buttons present but non-functional.
        *   Responsive design (target 1440px).
        *   No AI mentions.
        *   Finished, professional look.

    *   *Color Palette:* Professional blue and white (typical for EdTech), with a bright accent color for CTAs (orange or green).
    *   *Navigation:* Logo (学途), Courses, About/Teachers, Sign-up button.
    *   *Footer:* Contact info, Links, Copyright.

    *   *index.html*: Hero section (catchy slogan), Featured categories, Testimonials, Why choose us.
    *   *courses.html*: Filterable list of courses (Language, Computer, Exam Prep). Each card has a title, price, and "View Details" button.
    *   *course-detail.html*: Specific course (e.g., "Python for Beginners"), Syllabus (Lesson 1, 2, 3...), Teacher bio, Enrollment button.
    *   *signup.html*: Registration form (Name, Email, Password, Interest).

    *   *Course Categories:*
        *   Language: English for Business, Japanese N2, Spanish Basics.
        *   Computer: Python Programming, Data Analysis with Excel, UI/UX Design.
        *   Exam Prep: CFA Level 1, HSK 6, GRE/GMAT.
    *   *Prices:* Range from 199 CNY to 1299 CNY.

    *   *CSS:* Use a modern, clean sans-serif font stack. Flexbox/Grid for layout. Sticky header.
    *   *JS:* Simple tab switching or form validation simulation (though forms don't need to submit).
